description: Hashes and byte counts computed from the three installer files supplied for review on 2026-10-15. Hashes prove byte identity only; publisher/Authenticode validity must be checked on Windows.

webview2_standalone.note: Full x64 offline payload. The Evergreen URL can later serve different bytes; pin via an approved private artifact store for bit-identical release builds.

webview2_bootstrapper.note: Online bootstrapper; must never be passed as -WebView2StandaloneInstaller.
